members.name: UserAttackNPC
members.params: (userindex As Integer, Npcindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Player attacks NPC: hit calculation, damage, skill improvement, reputation, NPC death
notes: Duplicate of GameLogic.bas - use GameLogic as canonical

Swordmanship (Skill16) determines hit chance: <=30=1/3, <=50=1/2, >50=always hit. Damage = random(MinHIT,MaxHIT) - NPC.DEF/2, min 1. Makes NPC hostile on attack. Attacking guards = instant criminal (+60 min). On kill: gives EXP+gold, reputation changes (killing guard: -5 noble, +2 bendarr, +3 underworld; killing monster: +1 noble/common). Skills may improve (1/40 chance each swing for tactics/swordmanship/parrying).

members.name: NPCAttackUser
members.params: (Npcindex As Integer, userindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: NPC attacks player: hit calculation, damage, death check
notes: Duplicate of GameLogic.bas - use GameLogic as canonical

Normal guards skip non-criminals. Chaotic guards (Guard=2) skip Dark Elves and Haakis. Tactics (Skill6) determines dodge: <=20=never dodge, <=50=1/2-1/3, >50=1/2. Damage = random(NPC.MinHIT,NPC.MaxHIT) - user.DEF/2. Plays gender-specific hurt sound. NPC.CanAttack flag prevents double-hits (reset by client AT4 message).

members.name: UserAttackUser
members.params: (attackerindex As Integer, victimindex As Integer)

annotations.purpose: PvP combat: hit calculation, damage, criminal flagging, death
notes: Duplicate of GameLogic.bas - use GameLogic as canonical

Checks: both players must be >level 5, can't attack self, target can't be dead. Criminal flag if target not criminal and not in duel mode (+45 min). PK free zones block PvP. Damage same formula as UserAttackNPC. On kill: attacker gets EXP from victim, heavy reputation penalty (-20 noble, -5 overall, +5 bendarr).
